links.comparator_used: Static models trained once on 2015-2020 data and applied to later years without updating
links.outcome: Temporal robustness of grade ≥2 oral mucositis prediction on 2022 data (AUC, F1)
links.effect: Static models trained on 2015-2020 data fell in AUC from 0.81 internally to 0.74 on 2021 data and 0.68 on 2022 data. The Extra Trees transfer-learning ensemble reached AUC 0.87 and F1 0.82 on 2022 data.
links.quote: A Extras Trees transfer-learning ensemble achieved the best temporal robustness (AUC 0.87, F1 0.82) on 2022 data, demonstrating improved adaptability to drift.

design_hint: model updating/recalibration for temporal drift (recent data, transfer learning)
